---
pagetitle: "Blogs"
listing:
  # Chronological fallback, rendered only when every kind is disabled in
  # _post_visibility.yml. It also carries the site's only feed.
  #
  # Every listing sorts pinned posts first (see _pin_defaults.yml). The feed is
  # unaffected: Quarto builds it in date order regardless of the listing's
  # display sort, so RSS stays chronological however the sections are
  # configured and however posts are pinned. Verified against 1.9.36 -- see
  # docs/document_pins.md.
  - id: all-posts
    contents: posts
    include:
      sections-active: "false"
    feed: true
    sort: ["pinned desc", "pin-order asc", "date desc"]
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [date, reading-time, title, description, categories]
  - id: full-research
    contents: posts
    include:
      kind: full-research
      sections-active: "true"
    sort: ["pinned desc", "pin-order asc", "date desc"]
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [date, reading-time, title, description, categories]
  - id: mini-research
    contents: posts
    include:
      kind: mini-research
      sections-active: "true"
    sort: ["pinned desc", "pin-order asc", "date desc"]
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [date, reading-time, title, description, categories]
  - id: explanatory
    contents: posts
    include:
      kind: explanatory
      sections-active: "true"
    sort: ["pinned desc", "pin-order asc", "date desc"]
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [date, reading-time, title, description, categories]
  - id: misc
    contents: posts
    include:
      kind: misc
      sections-active: "true"
    sort: ["pinned desc", "pin-order asc", "date desc"]
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    fields: [date, reading-time, title, description, categories]
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
comments: false
---

::: {.post-kind-fallback data-post-fallback="true"}
::: {#all-posts}
:::
:::

::: {.post-kind-section data-post-kind="full-research"}
## Full Research Project Posts

Completed research projects with their methods, experiments, and conclusions. Note: some work may be replications of existing papers.

::: {#full-research}

:::

Intermediate investigations and milestones within a broader research project.
